User Story

As a system user

I want to be able to Payment package to be created automatically in the system

So that I will have opportunity to manage payments easier

Design: Payment_Package (adobe.com)

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Creating a Payment package is possible from Payment package’s listing page by clicking on a ‘Plus’ button

  2. Clicking on a Plus button will open Payment package’s creation page

  3. Check system user permissions to be able to create a new Payment Package

    1. Permission - Create a Payment Package (manual)

    2. Enable Plus button when user has permission

    3. Disable Plus button when user does not have permission

  4. Creating a Payment package is possible also automatically

  5. Triggers for automatic payment package creation:

    1. Offline payment - manual mass import

      1. Should be created for each import for each collection channel

      2. it is possible to have more than one payment package created for one collection channel in one day

    2. Offline payment - automatic mass import

      1. Should be created for each import for each collection channel

      2. it is possible to have more than one payment package created for one collection channel in one day

    3. Online payment

      1. Should be created only once a day for online collection channel.

      2. First received payment via online collection channel should create payment package for this day

        1. if payment package is already created should link all online payments for the collection channel to this payment package

      3. After creation of the Late Payment Fine for the day for the collection channel the payment package should be locked automatically

  6. One payment package can be addressed only to one collection channel

  7. Default state of Payment package object contains fields: 

    1. Number

      1. Text field

      2. Always disabled

      3. Automatically generated by system

    2. Unlocked/Locked

      1. Radio button

      2. Mandatory

      3. if payment package is created via offline payment the it should be created automatically with unlocked status and should be locked automatically after all payments from this import are created

      4. if payment package is created via online payment the it should be created automatically with unlocked status and should be locked automatically after creation of the last payment for the day for the collection channel

    3. Collection Channel

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown

        1. All active collection channels should be visible

        2. Only the name should be displayed

        3. Order should be alphabetical

        4. Display search bat if number of items are more than 10 items in the dropdown list

          1. It is possible to search the collection channels by its name

        5. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

      3. Filled automatically according by payment which was trigger for this payment package creation if the payment package is created automatically

    4. Accounting Period

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown

        1. By default should be display accounting period respective for current month

        2. All ‘Open’ Accounting Periods should be visible

        3. Only the accounting number should be displayed

        4. Order should be creation time DESC - last created accounting period should be visible first

        5. Display Search Bar if number of items are more than 10 items in dropdown list

          1. It is possible to search by its name

        6. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

      3. Filled automatically and should be respective for payment date if the payment package is created automatically

      4. if accounting period is closed for this date should return an error

    5. Payment Date

      1. Mandatory

      2. Date picker

      3. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      4. Data should be displayed in between 01.01.1990 to 31.12.2090

      5. It is possible to define date as current day or in the past

      6. Payment date should have validation to be respective for chosen accounting period range

        1. E.g., if current open accounting period is April, can’t add payment in May or in March

      7. Filled automatically according by payment if the payment package is created automatically

    6. History

      1. In this sub-object system should set changes regarding the statuses of the Payment package

      2. Historical record should be set for every change

      3. Records should have the following format:

        1. Day.Month.Year Hour:Minutes - action

        2. Action for the sub-object is Unlocked or Locked. There is no other possibilities.

        3. Records in the sub-object are not clickable as they are only for the informational data

        4. For example:

          1. 01.11.2023 00:00 - Lock

          2. 02.11.2023 17:39 - Unlocked

          3. 09.11.2023 18:25 - Locked

    7. Error Protocol

      1. System should set the generated files in this sub-object

      2. It is possible to click on file or an arrow and system should download it

      3. All payments which are not fully covered and which are connected to this payment package should be listed in generated excel. Should display columns:

        1. Payment ID

        2. Initial amount

        3. Amount which wasn’t used for liability cover

        4. Linked receivable object which was created after offsetting process

    8. Audit Log record should be created
